# @zyvnox/vue-pack

> Enterprise-grade, schema-driven Vue 3 component library & developer toolkit built with TypeScript and UnoCSS. Features schema-driven FormModal, interactive TabelData suite, 25+ validated inputs, real-time SEO engine, and full i18n support.

- Docs: https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/getting-started
- Live Playground: https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/playground
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/zyvnox/vue-pack
- NPM Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zyvnox/vue-pack
- Full LLM Context: https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/llms-full.txt

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install @zyvnox/vue-pack zod
```

```ts
// main.ts
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import App from './App.vue'
import VuePack from '@zyvnox/vue-pack/vue'
import '@zyvnox/vue-pack/style.css'

const app = createApp(App)
app.use(VuePack)
app.mount('#app')
```

## Core Architecture & Subpath Exports

- `@zyvnox/vue-pack`: Core bundle with tree-shaking support
- `@zyvnox/vue-pack/components`: All individual UI components (FormModal, TabelData, TextInput, etc.)
- `@zyvnox/vue-pack/config`: Reactive configuration manager and locale controller
- `@zyvnox/vue-pack/init`: App initialization helpers and plugins
- `@zyvnox/vue-pack/indexedDB`: Persistent client-side IndexedDB caching engine
- `@zyvnox/vue-pack/secureFetch`: CSRF/XSRF-protected fetch utility
- `@zyvnox/vue-pack/type`: Complete TypeScript type declarations and schema contracts

## Core Engines

- [FormModal](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/form-modal): Schema-driven modal form generator powered by declarative schema contracts with Zod validation, multi-tab layout, and built-in SEO calculation.
- [TabelData](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/tabel-data): High-performance data table component supporting server-side pagination, real-time search, multi-column sorting, selection, and custom actions.
- [SEO Studio](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/seo-studio): Real-time on-page SEO calculation engine evaluating keyword density, heading distribution, meta character limits, and SERP previews.

## Input Components (25 Validated Inputs)

- [TextInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/text-input): Single-line text input with custom tooltips, duplicate checks, and regex pattern validation.
- [NumberInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/number-input): Numeric input with step controls, minimum/maximum boundaries, and formatting.
- [CurrencyInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/currency-input): Localized monetary input supporting IDR, USD, EUR, and custom currency masks.
- [EmailInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/email-input): Email input with RFC 5322 compliance and custom domain restrictions.
- [PasswordInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/password-input): Secure password field with reveal toggle and strength indicator.
- [TelInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/tel-input): International telephone input with country dial codes and formatting.
- [UrlInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/url-input): Validated URL input for HTTPS links and repository paths.
- [TextAreaInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/text-area-input): Multi-line text area with auto-resize and character counter.
- [TextAreaQuillInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/text-area-quill): Rich-text WYSIWYG editor powered by Quill 2.0 with HTML and delta bindings.
- [SelectedOptions (Combobox)](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/combobox): Searchable combobox dropdown with keyboard navigation and remote query resolution.
- [TagInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/tag-input): Interactive chip/tag input supporting custom delimiters and duplicate prevention.
- [ColorPicker](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/color-picker): HEX and RGBA color selection tool with preset palette swatches.
- [DateInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/date-input): Localized calendar date picker with date range constraints.
- [TimeInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/time-input): Time picker supporting 12-hour AM/PM and 24-hour military formats.
- [DateTimeInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/date-time-input): Combined timestamp input for precise scheduling.
- [FileInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/file-input): Single file upload dropzone with MIME-type and size validation.
- [FileArrayInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/file-array-input): Multi-file batch dropzone with progress indicators and file list management.
- [ImageInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/image-input): Image upload component with instant aspect-ratio preview, remote URL support, and watermark overlay.
- [ImageArrayInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/image-array-input): Multi-image gallery uploader with thumbnail ordering.
- [ToggleInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/toggle-input): Boolean switch toggle with customizable status colors.
- [RateInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/rate-input): Star rating feedback component with fractional support.
- [LocationPicker (MapPicker)](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/location-picker): Interactive Leaflet map coordinate picker with GPS geolocation, GeoJSON boundary validation, and geocoding.
- [ArrayObjectInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/array-object): Dynamic sub-form repeater for arrays of objects (e.g. invoice items, variants).
- [ObjectInput](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/object-input): Nested object schema handler for hierarchical data structures.
- [GroupRenderer](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/group-renderer): Conditional form section generator that renders sub-schemas based on field values.

## Feedback & Display Components

- [AlertApp](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/alert-app): Toast notifications and alert banners with danger, warning, success, and info themes.
- [Loader](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/loader): 60fps dual-ring spinner with success, warning, and error state transitions.
- [WarningForm](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/warning-form): Modal confirmation dialog for destructive and warning operations.
- [SafeHtml](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/safe-html): XSS-sanitized HTML renderer powered by DOMPurify.
- [Tooltip](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/tooltip): Hover guidance tooltip with top, bottom, left, and right placement.
- [ModalDetailData](https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/doc/examples/modal-detail-data): Read-only modal inspector for structured object inspection.
